Trig Identity Proof (CBSE 2023), Class 10 board, 5 marks: prove (sin θ − cos θ + 1)/(sin θ + cos θ − 1) = (1 + sin θ)/cos θ with one trick.

• Divide every term by cos θ: (tan θ − 1 + sec θ)/(tan θ + 1 − sec θ)
• Rearrange to ((sec θ + tan θ) − 1)/(tan θ − sec θ + 1)
• The trick: write 1 = sec²θ − tan²θ = (sec θ + tan θ)(sec θ − tan θ)
• Take (sec θ + tan θ) common: the bracket [1 − sec θ + tan θ] cancels with the denominator
• sec θ + tan θ = 1/cos θ + sin θ/cos θ = (1 + sin θ)/cos θ = RHS
